name: Colombia
administering_agency: Ministerio de Relaciones Exteriores, with an outside body that sets the method and marking

exemptions.age: People over 65 are excused from the examinations.

fee.covers: The naturalization procedure as a whole, as listed by the ministry; not the examinations alone.

notes: Covers the Constitution, national history, culture and geography of Colombia, and Spanish for those whose mother tongue it is not. People who finished secondary school or a degree in Colombia are excused. Two attempts are allowed; the date is notified a month ahead.
